'''Blessed Souls''' was a Star Wars CCG fan database at <code>blessed-souls.mine.sk</code> (a Slovak mine.sk host), titled '''SWCCG - Database'''. It listed championship years 1996–2007, player pages, deck pages, pictures, and movies, and named [[Players Committee]] (<code>swccgpc.com</code>) and a Holotable host as partners.<ref name="tco">[https://web.archive.org/web/20201114131040id_/https://t.co/RCNHte1tcY SWCCG - Database] (Wayback 14 November 2020 <code>id_</code> capture of t.co/RCNHte1tcY, which stored the destination HTML)</ref><ref name="tweet">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1327598657764356098 @swccg], 14 November 2020 (#swccg25to25, 2000 part 3/3). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20201114131032/https://twitter.com/swccg/status/1327598657764356098 Internet Archive].</ref>

On 14 November 2020 the Players Committee X account pointed to the database for the 2000 Worlds finalists’ decklists (#swccg25to25, 2000 part 3 of 3).<ref name="tweet" /> The live hostname did not resolve under a matching certificate in 2026. A later capture of the same hostname is a different Slovak World of Warcraft guild also named Blessed Souls.

== Homepage contents ==

Year navigation ran 1996 through 2007. Championship-name keywords on the homepage include [[Raphael Asselin]], [[Bjørn Sørgjerd]], [[Philipp Jacobs]], [[Michael Riboulet]], [[Matt Potter]], [[Gary Carman]], [[Steven Lewis]], [[Matt Sokol]], [[Yannick Lapointe]], [[Bastian Winkelhaus]], [[Martin Akesson]], [[Angelo Consoli]], [[Greg Shaw]], [[Jonny Chu]], [[Brandon Schele]], [[Reid Smith]], [[Drew Scott]], and [[James Booker]].<ref name="tco" />

For 2000 Worlds the homepage linked:<ref name="tco" />

* [[Matt Sokol]] Light ''Hidden Base'' and Dark ''ISB''
* [[Yannick Lapointe]] Light '''''The Machine Killa''''' and Dark '''''The Machine'''''

For the [[2000 European Championship]] the homepage listed [[Martin Akesson]] (Sweden) with decks '''Missing''', and [[Maarten Rossou]] (Netherlands; listed as "Maarten Rousseau") with all fields '''Missing'''.<ref name="tco" />

== Preservation ==

* Homepage HTML: Wayback <code>id_</code> of t.co/RCNHte1tcY, 14 November 2020.<ref name="tco" />
* Live URL named in that post: <code>http://blessed-souls.mine.sk/</code>; the database itself was at [http://blessed-souls.mine.sk/swccg/Index.html blessed-souls.mine.sk/swccg/]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080203042106/http://blessed-souls.mine.sk:80/swccg/Index.html Wayback, 3 February 2008].
* Year pages and some player picture/movie pages survive in 2008 captures, e.g. the [http://blessed-souls.mine.sk/swccg/2000.html 2000 page]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080203093752/http://blessed-souls.mine.sk:80/swccg/2000.html Wayback, 3 February 2008]. The 2000 Worlds deck pages were not captured.
